description: Returns the app's site: the Development address (the private preview every publish lands on) with the link that opens it (the app's share link; with the preview link turned off, the founder's own signed-in route) and the Live address (public, once a version is put live), the version each serves, whether the Live site is offline, every version (when, by whom, how many files and bytes, its status), how long the Development site has been idle, and each of the app's own domains for the Live site — its status (connecting, live, offline, needs attention, hosted elsewhere, not connected), whether the founder chose to show the Gemmein site there, and the one record to add when one is needed (never for a domain hosted elsewhere). env live reads from the Live side. Changes nothing. This is what a founder may call their website and its address.
name: site_status
title: The site
